title: Inject account-deletion transaction failures and verify cleanup convergence
classification: No new implementation defect reproduced; staged account-deletion changes roll back before commit, and post-unlink cleanup retries converge after a failed job commit.

change.verification: Added parameterized failure injection at file-candidate discovery, audit anonymization, relation deletion, user flush, cleanup-job enqueue, and the database commit boundary.
change.recovery_case: Added a failure after an owned file is unlinked but before the cleanup-job deletion commits; after rollback, the next retry sees the already-absent file and removes the retry row.

verification.result: passed: 19 tests on Python 3.14.10 and PostgreSQL 17.6.
verification.schema: Fresh uniquely named loopback PostgreSQL test database created and upgraded through Alembic revision d6e7f8a9b0c1 using scripts/upgrade_test_schema.py.
verification.cleanup: The disposable database was dropped after the passing run.
verification.assertions: Each pre-commit injected failure leaves the account, credential, and original audit text intact; preserves user-owned file bytes; and leaves no cleanup job. The post-unlink commit failure leaves a retryable job; a second processing pass removes the job without error.

limits: The fault injection exercises the deletion service and retry worker in-process; a prior separate R1978 test exercises retry during a fresh Uvicorn ASGI lifespan.
These checks use the current ORM/Alembic schema, not a deployed operator schema. Restore reapplication and production restart/retry qualification remain open.
